title: Lift wedge annihilates the exterior quotient kernel
statement: Let S be a short exact sequence A→B→C of sheaves of modules on a scheme X, with A finite locally free of rank r1 [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module], and let r2=r1+r3. Using exterior sheaves [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power], suppose q:(∧^r1 A)⊗(∧^r3 B)→(∧^r1 A)⊗(∧^r3 C) sends tensors of wedges to tensors with each second factor mapped under S.g. There exists w:(∧^r1 A)⊗(∧^r3 B)→∧^r2 B, sending each tensor of wedges to the concatenated wedge of the S.f images and the second tuple, and satisfying kernel.ι(q)≫w=0.

proof.text: Apply the official exteriorSheaf_wedgeMap_exists to S.f in degrees r1, r3, r2 with hr. It supplies w on the native exterior powers and precisely the concatenated-wedge formula.
Apply the official determinant_wedge_quotient_factor to q and w, using the supplied q formula and the constructed w formula. Obtain phi with q followed by phi equal to w.
Rewrite w as q followed by phi. Associativity, kernel.condition and zero_comp give kernel.ι(q) followed by w equal to zero. Pair this equality with the wedge formula.

proof_origin.place: Proof of (*), determinant paragraph; existing official wedge construction and factorization, followed by kernel.condition. The consumer transports the proved result through the canonical exterior-power comparisons.

lean.statement:
theorem determinant_liftWedge_kernel_exists {X : Scheme.{v}} (S : ShortComplex X.Modules)
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (r₁ r₂ r₃ : ℕ) (hr : r₂ = r₁ + r₃)
    [S.X₁.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₁]
    (q : exteriorPower S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorPower S.X₂ r₃ ⟶
      exteriorPower S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorPower S.X₃ r₃)
    (hq : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U))
      (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)),
      q.val.app (op U)
          (tmulSection (wedge (M := S.X₁) (r := r₁) (U := U) a)
            (wedge (M := S.X₂) (r := r₃) (U := U) c)) =
        tmulSection (M := exteriorPower S.X₁ r₁) (N := exteriorPower S.X₃ r₃)
          (wedge (M := S.X₁) (r := r₁) (U := U) a)
          (wedge (M := S.X₃) (r := r₃) (U := U) (fun i ↦ S.g.val.app (op U) (c i)))) :
    ∃ w : exteriorPower S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorPower S.X₂ r₃ ⟶ exteriorPower S.X₂ r₂,
      kernel.ι q ≫ w = 0 ∧ ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U))
        (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)),
        w.val.app (op U)
            (tmulSection (wedge (M := S.X₁) (r := r₁) (U := U) a)
              (wedge (M := S.X₂) (r := r₃) (U := U) c)) =
          wedge (M := S.X₂) (r := r₂) (U := U)
            (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op U) (a j)) c (Fin.cast hr i))
